simple.meaning: צִרְעָה (tsirʻâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a wasp (as stinging).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 23:28. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צִרְעָה (H6880) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: צִרְעָה (tsirʻâh) / H6880 is traced through Exodus 23:28, Deuteronomy 7:20, Joshua 24:12 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

timeline.evidenceText: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.
